title: Idea Diagnosis v1
description: The Idea Improvement Agent's diagnosis of an imported idea seed: what the mechanism currently claims, why it fell short, and which improvement routes follow — engineering fixes kept separate from scientific hypothesis changes. What is checked: the payload echoes the question and the seed snapshot it was asked about (that binding is what keeps a stored diagnosis traceable to one import), and that findings and routes come back with the fields the report prints (a route's `stopConditions` is typed but not required — improve.ts rejects a route whose list is missing or empty). What is NOT checked: that each evidence entry carries a source and a location, that those sources were actually offered in the context, that baselineStatus matches the evidence, that a hypothesis change was filed as a new-idea route rather than disguised code polish, and the `contract` name echo itself — improve.ts compares all of them against the request context this file cannot see. The failureCategories/area/kind vocabularies are generated into the prompt from TS consts, so they stay plain strings here rather than a copied enum that would reject valid output the day a category is added.
